facts.text: Viceroy Los Cabos is in San José del Cabo, Mexico.
facts.excerpt: **Location:** San José del Cabo, Mexico

facts.text: The resort sits about 20 minutes from Los Cabos International Airport (SJD).
facts.excerpt: Viceroy Los Cabos sits about 20 minutes from Los Cabos International Airport (SJD)

facts.text: The resort is just minutes from San José del Cabo, an old town of markets, art and quiet streets.
facts.excerpt: just minutes from San José del Cabo, the true Mexico is close at hand: an old town of markets, art, and quiet streets

facts.text: The resort sits along the edge of the Sea of Cortez with miles of white sand beach.
facts.excerpt: set along the edge of the Sea of Cortez with miles of white sand beach

facts.text: The resort was designed by Mexico City-based architect Miguel Ángel Aragonés.
facts.excerpt: Designed by Mexico City-based architect Miguel Ángel Aragonés, it’s a stark departure from the predictable

facts.text: Glass-and-concrete structures seem to almost float above the resort's saltwater pools.
facts.excerpt: Stroll among glass-and-concrete structures that seem to almost float above the resort’s saltwater pools.

facts.text: The design trades palapas and artisanal tile for minimalism.
facts.excerpt: the ubiquity of palapas and artisanal tile has been traded for the purity of minimalism

facts.text: The resort opened as Mar Adentro before Viceroy took it over.
facts.excerpt: Opened as Mar Adentro, Viceroy has taken over this stunning Miguel Ángel Aragonés-designed resort

facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and private outdoor space.

facts.text: Villas have rooftop pools.
facts.excerpt: Villas even have rooftop pools.

facts.text: Integrated in-room tech lets guests control lighting, music and drapes at the touch of a finger.
facts.excerpt: Integrated tech allows you to control lighting, music, and drapes at the touch of a finger

facts.text: The villas are modernist spaces with configurations for up to five bedrooms.
facts.excerpt: Nature-inspired, modernist spaces with configurations for up to five bedrooms

facts.text: The resort has an infinity-edge beachfront pool.
facts.excerpt: an infinity-edge beachfront pool

facts.text: The resort has an adults-only rooftop pool.
facts.excerpt: an adults-only rooftop pool

facts.text: Three pools sit around the family-friendly pool deck.
facts.excerpt: three pools around the family-friendly pool deck

facts.text: THE SPA has signature vitality pools, thermal rooms and a grotto.
facts.excerpt: a wellness retreat with signature vitality pools, thermal rooms, and a serene grotto to induce relaxation and stress relief

facts.text: The fitness center was designed in collaboration with Harley Pasternak.
facts.excerpt: visit our state-of-the-art fitness center, designed in collaboration with Harley Pasternak

facts.text: An intimate on-property theater has daily screenings for guests and can be reserved for private screenings.
facts.excerpt: Our luxe, intimate theater features daily screenings for guests, and can also be reserved for private movies and screenings.
